messages.text: For a Wireless Communication use case involving Wi-Fi 7/8, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

Short answer: Signaling testers fit in the R&D / validation / interworking part of the Wi‑Fi 7/8 workflow, while non-signaling testers fit mainly in production RF test, with limited R&D waveform/debug relevance where stated.[4][1][2][16]
| Workflow stage | Tester type | Wi‑Fi 7 / Wi‑Fi 8 placement |
|---|---|---|
| R&D design validation | Signaling tester | For Wi‑Fi 7, R&S CMX500 is positioned as a single-box, multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester for R&D testing of wireless-device operation across cellular and non-cellular standards.[2] Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing is described as requiring signaling mode and real-world conditions to measure RF TX/RX characteristics.[2] |
| R&D feature / system testing | Signaling tester | For Wi‑Fi 7, signaling workflow covers MLO-related testing because MLO is a key Wi‑Fi 7 feature and makes a multiple-RF-chain test environment important.[2] Listed Wi‑Fi 7 signaling test areas include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities.[2] |
| Interworking / application validation | Signaling tester | CMX500 is also placed in cellular 5G and WLAN interworking workflows, including WLAN offloading, Voice over WLAN handover during a voice call, N3IWF gateway-based offloading tests, and POLQA voice-quality evaluation.[6] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 early RF signaling / prototype validation | Signaling tester | For Wi‑Fi 8, CMX500 is described as a one-box signaling tester with Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn RF signaling mode test capability, demonstrated with a prototype next-generation WLAN device.[16] The Wi‑Fi 8 signaling context includes validation of Wi‑Fi 8 physical-layer features and testing hurdles such as dRU and UEQM.[12] |
| Production RF test | Non-signaling tester | For Wi‑Fi 7 production, all RF measurements are described as being performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and R&S CMP180 is positioned as optimized for this production non-signaling RF testing purpose.[1] |
| Production MIMO RF scaling | Non-signaling tester | CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined to support four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing.[1] |
| Wi‑Fi 8-adjacent waveform exploration | Non-signaling tester | CMP180 is described as demonstrating loopback verification of a 480 MHz WLAN waveform, but that waveform is only called a potential candidate for yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn and is not established as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification.[1][3] |
Therefore, the workflow split is: use signaling testers such as CMX500 earlier for R&D, real-world RF TX/RX, MLO/MIMO, coexistence, E2E, interworking, and Wi‑Fi 8 prototype RF signaling validation; use non-signaling testers such as CMP180 later for fast production RF measurements and scalable MIMO RF production test.[4][2][6][16][1]

answer.question: For a Wireless Communication use case involving Wi-Fi 7/8, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow? Explain test workflow placement for signaling and non-signaling testers in Wi-Fi 7/8.

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：新聞稿發布者與測試解決方案供應商。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：frontmatter author 與 R&S registered trademark 所屬公司名。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：R&D single-box signaling tester；本來源新增 Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality、WLAN offloading、N3IWF 與 POLQA voice quality measurement 的 PR 語境。
- [[R&S CMP180]]：production / R&D non-signaling tester；本來源宣稱支援 Wi-Fi 6E、Wi-Fi 7、5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz、bandwidths up to 500 MHz，並展示 480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback。
- [[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]]：本來源的主題概念，區分 CMX500 R&D signaling 與 CMP180 production non-signaling 測試。
- [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]：本來源描述的 CMX500 single-box interworking / voice continuity 測試情境。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]：來源列出 320 MHz channel bandwidth、up to 16 spatial streams、4096 QAM、低延遲與 high throughput。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]]：來源稱 yet-to-be-defined，且 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion；CMP180 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate。
- [[MLO]]：Wi-Fi 7 key feature，使 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 變重要。
- [[N3IWF]]：Non-3GPP Interworking Function gateway；來源稱 newly integrated in R&S CMX500。
- [[POLQA]]：來源稱 R&S CMX500 integrated POLQA voice quality measurement function 可用於 Voice over WLAN applications。
- [[MWC 2024]]：展示場合。
- [[Christian Mokry]]：Press & media contact。

- EMITE customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] and [[5G RedCap]] devices。

- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 聚焦 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 4G / 5G NR / WLAN OTA workflow。
- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 聚焦 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]]，並提到 [[NB-IoT NTN]] / [[NR NTN]] 作為下一步。

三者都是 PR / solution-level statements，不應替代正式 datasheet、configuration guide 或 certification documentation。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 下一步：NTN
來源說明下一步合作方向是 integrating test capabilities for [[NB-IoT NTN]] and [[NR NTN]]，且這些能力 already covered by [[R&S CMW500]] and [[R&S CMX500]]。

- [[3GPP Release 17]] defined 5G technology。
- reduced-functionality version of 5G。
- significantly lower cost compared to [[5G eMBB]]。
- mid-range data throughput。
- low power consumption。
- low complexity。
- ability to support a large number of devices。
- particularly attractive for [[IoT]] applications。

本頁只記錄來源中的 solution-level 說法；不推論 RedCap UE category、band support、3GPP test case coverage、RF measurements、protocol conformance 或 certification scope。

- low latency。
- ultra-high-definition video streaming。
- immersive virtual reality。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。

- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。

- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

Short answer: Signaling testers fit in the R&D / validation / interworking part of the Wi‑Fi 7/8 workflow, while non-signaling testers fit mainly in production RF test, with limited R&D waveform/debug relevance where stated.[4][1][2][16]
| Workflow stage | Tester type | Wi‑Fi 7 / Wi‑Fi 8 placement |
|---|---|---|
| R&D design validation | Signaling tester | For Wi‑Fi 7, R&S CMX500 is positioned as a single-box, multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester for R&D testing of wireless-device operation across cellular and non-cellular standards.[2] Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing is described as requiring signaling mode and real-world conditions to measure RF TX/RX characteristics.[2] |
| R&D feature / system testing | Signaling tester | For Wi‑Fi 7, signaling workflow covers MLO-related testing because MLO is a key Wi‑Fi 7 feature and makes a multiple-RF-chain test environment important.[2] Listed Wi‑Fi 7 signaling test areas include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities.[2] |
| Interworking / application validation | Signaling tester | CMX500 is also placed in cellular 5G and WLAN interworking workflows, including WLAN offloading, Voice over WLAN handover during a voice call, N3IWF gateway-based offloading tests, and POLQA voice-quality evaluation.[6] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 early RF signaling / prototype validation | Signaling tester | For Wi‑Fi 8, CMX500 is described as a one-box signaling tester with Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn RF signaling mode test capability, demonstrated with a prototype next-generation WLAN device.[16] The Wi‑Fi 8 signaling context includes validation of Wi‑Fi 8 physical-layer features and testing hurdles such as dRU and UEQM.[12] |
| Production RF test | Non-signaling tester | For Wi‑Fi 7 production, all RF measurements are described as being performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and R&S CMP180 is positioned as optimized for this production non-signaling RF testing purpose.[1] |
| Production MIMO RF scaling | Non-signaling tester | CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined to support four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing.[1] |
| Wi‑Fi 8-adjacent waveform exploration | Non-signaling tester | CMP180 is described as demonstrating loopback verification of a 480 MHz WLAN waveform, but that waveform is only called a potential candidate for yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn and is not established as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification.[1][3] |
Therefore, the workflow split is: use signaling testers such as CMX500 earlier for R&D, real-world RF TX/RX, MLO/MIMO, coexistence, E2E, interworking, and Wi‑Fi 8 prototype RF signaling validation; use non-signaling testers such as CMP180 later for fast production RF measurements and scalable MIMO RF production test.[4][2][6][16][1]

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity › 重點摘要
- 來源未標示發布日期；raw frontmatter `created: 2026-09-11`，本文 ingest 日期為 2026-09-15。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱在最終 IEEE standard ratification 之前，已將 first [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 實作到 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester。
- 展示情境：[[MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[Rohde & Schwarz]] booth 5A80，Fira Gran Via Barcelona，hall 5。
- 測試對象：[[Broadcom]] prototype next-generation WLAN device / prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的焦點被描述為從 sheer speed 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）performance。
- 來源稱 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 延續 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 的 core PHY parameters：supported frequencies up to 7.125 GHz、channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz、4096QAM modulation、[[MLO]]。
- 來源列出 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的新 testing hurdles，包括 [[distributed resource units]]（dRU）與 [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）。
- dRU measurements 被描述為可驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness。
- UEQM analysis 被描述為可評估 test device 是否能依 specified modulation coding scheme（MCS）combinations 正確 adapt modulation。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被定位為 modular、powerful one-box signaling tester，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR]] SA/NSA、[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、Direct-to-Cell（[[D2C]] / [[DTC]]）與 WLAN including [[Wi‑Fi 7]] and [[Wi‑Fi 8]]。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
